extracted.intended_audience: small business applicants preparing SBIR/STTR grant applications (principal investigators and grant administrators)
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare the Research & Related budget, budget justification, SBIR/STTR eligibility questions, and a commercialization plan for an SBIR/STTR Phase I/II or Phase II application, including subaward budgets and regulatory/commercialization evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Senior/Key Person budget entries
rubrics_metrics.description: A. Senior/KeyPerson: Prefix, FirstName, MiddleName, LastName, Suffix, ProjectRole, BaseSalary($), Cal.Months, Acad.Months, Sum.Months, RequestedSalary($), FringeBenefits($), FundsRequested($). TotalFundsRequested for all Senior/KeyPersons in the attached file; provide AdditionalSeniorKeyPersons file if needed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide full name, role, months of effort (calendar/academic/summer), base salary and the requested salary and fringe for each senior/key person; include totals and attach additional files for extra senior/key personnel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other personnel budget entries
rubrics_metrics.description: B. OtherPersonnel: Number of personnel and by project role (PostDoctoralAssociates, GraduateStudents, UndergraduateStudents, Secretarial/Clerical, etc.), Cal.Months, Acad.Months, Sum.Months, RequestedSalary($), FringeBenefits, FundsRequested($). Report TotalNumberOtherPersonnel and TotalSalary, Wages and FringeBenefits (A+B).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Break out counts, months of effort, salaries and fringe by personnel category and provide totals combining Senior/Key and Other personnel salary/fringe.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment listing and dollar thresholds
rubrics_metrics.description: C. Equipment: "List items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000"; EquipmentItem and FundsRequested($) fields required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Itemize each equipment purchase > $5,000 with description and cost. In the budget justification explain the need/utility (examples in text: Virtis Advantage Plus Freeze Dryer XL, spectrophotometer Shimadzu UV1800, Bio-Dot rotary cutter) and how it supports project aims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Travel costs (domestic and foreign)
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Travel: separate DomesticTravelCosts (Incl. Canada, Mexico, and U.S. Possessions) and ForeignTravelCosts; provide FundsRequested($) for each.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include number/purpose of trips, per-trip breakdown (travel, lodging, per diem) and justification (e.g., collaborative face-to-face meeting).

rubrics_metrics.name: Participant/trainee support costs
rubrics_metrics.description: E. Participant/TraineeSupportCosts: Tuition/Fees/HealthInsurance, Stipends, Travel, Subsistence, Other, and NumberOfParticipants/Trainees; TotalParticipant/TraineeSupportCosts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the project includes trainees or participants, provide per-category costs and participant counts and aggregate totals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Direct Costs categories
rubrics_metrics.description: F. OtherDirectCosts: include 1. Materials and Supplies, 2. Publication Costs, 3. Consultant Services, 4. ADP/Computer Services, 5. Subawards/Consortium/ContractualCosts, 6. Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees, 7. Alterations and Renovations; TotalOtherDirectCosts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide line-item amounts and justifications for each other direct cost category; include subaward/consortium contractual costs separately and justify scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct and indirect cost totals and F&A documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: G. DirectCostsFundsRequested (TotalDirectCosts A thru F); H. IndirectCosts: IndirectCostType, IndirectCostRate(%), IndirectCostBase($), FundsRequested($); I. TotalDirectandIndirectCostsFundsRequested (TotalDirectandIndirectInstitutionalCosts (G+H)); include CognizantFederalAgency (AgencyName, POCName, and POCPhoneNumber).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report total direct costs and compute indirect (F&A) using an approved rate. Document the cognizant federal agency and POC for the negotiated F&A rate; example shows F&A rate (e.g., 30%) and note 'F&A rate approved by DFAS'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget justification file requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: K. *BudgetJustificationFileName: MimeType: application/pdf (Only attach one file.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach a single PDF budget justification that explains personnel roles and percent effort, supplies, equipment, travel, fringe, and F&A calculations. The narrative should justify each major cost and provide totals by year and across project period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subaward/consortium budgeting and cumulative totals
rubrics_metrics.description: For each Subaward/Consortium: provide Organizational DUNS, BudgetType (Project/Subaward/Consortium), Enter name of Organization, StartDate, EndDate, BudgetPeriod, full budget sections (A–K) for the subaward; report RESEARCH & RELATED Budget - Cumulative Budget Totals and Section summaries (A–F).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare separate budgets and justifications for each subaward/consortium member with start/end dates and include cumulative totals across subawards and prime award. Ensure subaward personnel and cost categories mirror the prime budget entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Small business eligibility and SBIR/STTR program selections
rubrics_metrics.description: SBIR/STTR Information: "Do you certify that at the time of award your organization will meet the eligibility criteria for a small business as defined in the funding opportunity announcement?" Also select Program Type and SBIR/STTR Type.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Certify small business eligibility at award time and choose the correct program/type (SBIR, STTR, Phase I, Phase II, Fast-Track) following agency-specific FOA instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of subcontracts with federal laboratories/agencies
rubrics_metrics.description: Question: "Does this application include subcontracts with Federal laboratories or any other Federal Government agencies? If yes, insert the names of the Federal laboratories/agencies."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose all subcontracting relationships with federal laboratories/agencies and include names; provide explanations or attachments if required.

rubrics_metrics.name: HUBZone and location-of-R&D declarations
rubrics_metrics.description: Questions: "Are you located in a HUBZone?" and "Will all research and development on the project be performed in its entirety in the United States?" Provide explanations or use mapping utility as instructed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate HUBZone status (use SBA mapping utility) and state whether R&D will be entirely in the U.S.; if not, provide explanation and justification as required by the FOA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior or concurrent federal support disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Question: "Has the applicant and/or Program Director/Principal Investigator submitted proposals for essentially equivalent work under other Federal program solicitations or received other Federal awards for essentially equivalent work? If yes, insert the names of the other Federal agencies."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose prior or concurrent submissions/awards for essentially equivalent work and list agencies; attach an explanation if necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure permission and contact information release
rubrics_metrics.description: Question: Disclosure Permission Statement: If this application does not result in an award, is the Government permitted to disclose the title of your proposed project, and the name, address, telephone number and e-mail address of the official signing for the applicant organization, to organizations that may be interested in contacting you for further information?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate whether the government may disclose basic contact and project title information if application is not funded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commercialization Plan requirement and contents
rubrics_metrics.description: For Phase II or Phase I/Phase II Fast-Track: include a Commercialization Plan in accordance with the agency announcement and/or agency-specific instructions. The commercialization plan should describe value of the SBIR project, expected outcomes, impact, market/commercial strategy, manufacturing and regulatory strategy, and company capabilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commercialization Plan should include: assessment of state-of-field and unmet need; description of novel technology and comparative advantages; expected outcomes (e.g., optimized product within Phase II, cassette format production); plans for multi-site field studies to determine sensitivity, specificity, false recency rate, reproducibility, stability, and effects of interfering substances; regulatory submission strategy (e.g., submit to FDA for waiver for non-diagnostic surveillance use, to European notified body, and regional regulatory agencies); manufacturing partner arrangements and scale-up plans; projected timeline (e.g., launch by end of Phase II); and evidence of company commercialization capability (staffing, QA/quality systems, prior FDA 510(k) approvals, ISO13485 certification, prior clinical trial experience). Include attachments as specified by the FOA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Anticipated personnel and prior SBIR history
rubrics_metrics.description: Question: Provide anticipated number of personnel to be employed at your organization at the time of award; Question 8: "Have you received SBIR Phase II awards from the Federal Government? If yes, provide a company commercialization history in accordance with agency-specific instructions using this attachment."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supply staffing projections and when applicable attach a company commercialization history for prior SBIR Phase II recipients per agency instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: PI employment and minimum effort requirements (STTR-specific)
rubrics_metrics.description: Questions: Will the Project Director/Principal Investigator have his/her primary employment with the small business at the time of award? And for STTR: (1) Does the PD/PI have a formal appointment/commitment with the small business OR with the research institution which has committed to the small business; AND (2) Will the PD/PI devote at least 10% effort to the proposed project?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer employment status and for STTR ensure the PD/PI meets the formal appointment/commitment requirement and will devote a minimum of 10% effort; document appointments/commitments as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work-share percentages for SBIR/STTR collaborations
rubrics_metrics.description: Question: "In the joint research and development proposed in this project, does the small business perform at least 40% of the work and the research institution named in the application perform at least 30% of the work?" (applies to STTR).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For STTR projects, ensure and document that the small business will perform ≥40% of the R&D and the partnering research institution will perform ≥30% of the R&D; provide justification and budget allocation consistent with these percentages.
